description.value: Black Swift Vineyards is a single-vineyard winery perched in the hills of West Kelowna, part of the Jason Parkes Customs family of wineries and tasting rooms on the Westside. The tasting room is open daily with a casual, no-reservations-needed atmosphere, offering guided tastings and vineyard tours by golf cart. Named after the elusive Black Swift bird that lays just one egg per season, the winery emphasizes restraint and terroir-driven winemaking.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Black Swift Vineyards is an active winery tasting room in West Kelowna, open daily. Contact page corroborates the OSM address (2345 Boucherie Road, West Kelowna, V1Z 2E6), phone ((778) 755-3275), and email. No mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. The tasting room is described as laid-back, dog-friendly, and walk-in friendly, but no bike-related details are provided.
